info.name: LMS-13 | UC7.1 Local User Administration
info.description: DOC-05 user administration: list, detail and access updates at /api/v1/admin/users. Snake_case response fields and one-based pagination. See docs/admin-user-management.md for fixtures, aliases, audit semantics and verification. Set tokens locally. Run against a disposable database with one active administrator, a separate active student and a third target; ordered mutations leave the target ACTIVE/TUTOR.

variable.description: LMS origin without trailing slash; application default port 8081.
Local-only JWT for an ACTIVE local ADMINISTRATOR; omit Bearer prefix.
Local-only JWT for a separate ACTIVE local STUDENT, distinct from target_user_id; omit Bearer prefix.
Existing disposable non-admin UUID, distinct from both token subjects. Mutations leave this user ACTIVE/TUTOR.

item.name: 2.5 Last-Active-Admin Protection
item.description: Requires exactly one ACTIVE ADMINISTRATOR. Before each PATCH, a read-only authenticated preflight checks this and derives last_active_admin_id without changing target_user_id. A missing prerequisite fails an assertion and skips the mutation. Use a runtime supporting pm.execution.skipRequest(). Run with other administrator writers idle; this preflight is not a transaction or a concurrency test.

exec: pm.test('Prerequisite: exactly one active administrator', function () {
pm.expect(page.total_items, 'Use a fixture with exactly one ACTIVE ADMINISTRATOR').to.eql(1);
pm.expect(body.message).to.eql("Cannot demote or suspend the last active administrator");

item.name: 2.6 Invalid bodies - 400
item.description: A missing body or whole-body null is invalid. Empty object and null fields are accepted; see 2.8.

request.description: A required request body is absent. This is different from the valid empty JSON object {}.

OWNER is not an allowed LMS role.

Incomplete JSON must be rejected before the service updates access.
